watchHint.zh: 监控目录中的直接文件。
watchHint.en: Monitors files directly inside each folder.

scopeHint.zh: 目录密码也适用于其子目录。
scopeHint.en: Folder passwords also apply to subfolders.

rootOutput.zh: 输出目录；留空使用默认位置
rootOutput.en: Output folder; leave blank for the default

noTasks.zh: 没有符合筛选条件的任务。

startupDescription.zh: 登录 Windows 后自动监控目录。
startupDescription.en: Automatically monitor folders when you sign in to Windows.

themeDescription.zh: 选择管理面板的显示外观。

batchHint.zh: 每行一个密码，可粘贴多行；保留空格和 #，忽略空行。
batchHint.en: One password per line. Paste multiple lines; spaces and # are kept. Empty lines are skipped.

scopeDescription.zh: 每行一个绝对目录；新密码留空表示适用于全部目录。
scopeDescription.en: One absolute folder per line. Leave blank for new passwords to apply everywhere.

scopeGuard.zh: 目录密码不能直接清空适用目录。请移除当前目录，或选择“适用于全部目录”。
scopeGuard.en: To remove the last folder, remove the password from that folder or choose Apply everywhere.

fileProblems.zh: 部分数据暂时无法读取
fileProblems.en: Some data could not be read

cliEncoding.zh: 命令输出不是有效的 UTF-8。
cliEncoding.en: The command output is not valid UTF-8.

unknownDescription.zh: 附加配置；保留原值及其他未知配置。
unknownDescription.en: Additional setting. Other unrecognized values are preserved.

validation.zh: 输入值不符合此项说明。
validation.en: Enter a value within the limits described above.

conflict.zh: 该项已被其他程序修改。刷新后重新编辑。
conflict.en: This setting changed in another program. Refresh and edit it again.

description.zh: 管理面板和命令行共同使用此语言；保存后立即切换。
description.en: Used by the manager and CLI. The manager updates immediately after saving.

description.zh: 选择持续递归、每轮询问，或输入要处理的轮数（至少 1）。
description.en: Keep processing nested archives, ask after each round, or set a number of rounds (at least 1).

description.zh: 根据压缩包占比与项目结构决定是否继续递归。
description.en: Use archive ratios and project structure to decide whether to recurse.

description.zh: 必须大于 0。
description.en: Must be greater than 0.

description.zh: 必须大于 0。
description.en: Must be greater than 0.

description.zh: 对递归授权分数的调整量；有限数值。
description.en: Adjustment to the recursion score; a finite number.

description.zh: 取值 0–1；达到此分数才授权递归。
description.en: From 0 to 1. Minimum score for recursion authorization.

description.zh: 取值 0–1；参与递归授权的字节占比下限。
description.en: From 0 to 1. Minimum archive byte ratio for recursion authorization.

description.zh: 非负整数；递归授权允许的其他项目数量上限。
description.en: Non-negative integer. Maximum other projects allowed by recursion authorization.

description.zh: 仅在解压成功后处理原始压缩包。永久删除无法通过回收站恢复。
description.en: Applies after a successful extraction. Permanently deleted archives cannot be restored from the Recycle Bin.

description.zh: 输出只有一个顶层文件夹时，将其中内容上移一层。
description.en: Move contents up one level when the output contains a single top-level folder.

description.zh: 选择只处理当前目录，或同时扫描子目录。监控模式仍只处理根目录中的直接文件。
description.en: Scan the selected folder only or include subfolders. Watch still handles files directly inside each monitored folder.

description.zh: 根据下面的路径、扩展名、大小和时间规则筛选输入。扩展名规则可能排除伪装压缩包。
description.en: Filter inputs by path, extension, size and time. Extension rules can exclude archives with disguised names.

description.zh: 启用此项规则或模块。
description.en: Enable this rule or module.

description.zh: 每行一个通配符规则；匹配的目录不再进入。
description.en: One glob per line. Matching directories are not entered.

description.zh: 每行一个路径通配符规则。
description.en: One path glob per line.

description.zh: 启用此项规则或模块。
description.en: Enable this rule or module.

description.zh: 每行一个路径通配符规则。
description.en: One path glob per line.

description.zh: 每行一个通配符规则；匹配的目录不再进入。
description.en: One glob per line. Matching directories are not entered.

description.zh: 每行一个文件名。
description.en: One allowed file name per line.

description.zh: 每行一个扩展名。扩展名筛选可能排除伪装压缩包。
description.en: One extension per line. Extension filters can exclude disguised archives.

description.zh: 启用此项规则或模块。
description.en: Enable this rule or module.

description.zh: 每行一个要排除的文件名。
description.en: One excluded file name per line.

description.zh: 每行一个扩展名。伪装为这些扩展名的压缩包也会被排除。
description.en: One extension per line. Archives disguised with these extensions are also excluded.

description.zh: 启用此项规则或模块。
description.en: Enable this rule or module.

description.zh: 例如 r > 0 B；支持大小比较表达式。
description.en: For example, r > 0 B. Supports size comparison expressions.

description.zh: 启用此项规则或模块。
description.en: Enable this rule or module.

label.zh: CLI 服务空闲释放时间

description.zh: 秒；持续空闲后释放 CLI 服务。
description.en: Idle seconds before the CLI server exits.

description.zh: 秒；worker 长时间没有进展时的超时限制。
description.en: Seconds allowed without worker progress.

description.zh: 非负整数；0 使用自动容量。
description.en: Non-negative integer; 0 uses automatic capacity.

description.zh: 非负整数；0 使用自动容量。
description.en: Non-negative integer; 0 uses automatic capacity.

description.zh: 至少 1；允许排队的阶段任务数。
description.en: At least 1. Maximum queued stage jobs.

description.zh: 至少 1；worker 任务队列长度上限。
description.en: At least 1. Maximum worker queue length.

description.zh: 至少 1；防止低优先级任务长期等待。
description.en: At least 1. Aging quantum for waiting jobs.

description.zh: 非负整数；发生背压时允许的重试次数。
description.en: Non-negative integer. Retry limit under backpressure.

description.zh: 至少 1；异步输出使用的写入线程数。
description.en: At least 1. Number of asynchronous output writer threads.

description.zh: 字节；每个任务使用的缓冲区预算。
description.en: Bytes budgeted for each job’s buffers.

description.zh: 资源不足时由 worker 的既有调度路径控制任务准入。
description.en: Use the worker’s resource gate to control task admission when resources are low.

description.zh: 毫秒；worker 已被资源门控阻止时的复查间隔。
description.en: Milliseconds between resource checks for gated worker jobs.

description.zh: 毫秒；资源不足期间报告状态的间隔。
description.en: Milliseconds between reports while resources are low.

description.zh: 取值 0–1；低于阈值时触发资源门控。
description.en: From 0 to 1. Available-memory threshold for the resource gate.

description.zh: 后台模式减少资源争用；高优先级用于优先完成解压。
description.en: Background reduces resource contention; High prioritizes extraction.

description.zh: 秒；新候选首次处理前的等待时间。
description.en: Seconds before a new candidate is processed.

description.zh: 秒；文件停止变化后的最短等待时间。
description.en: Minimum seconds after a file stops changing.

description.zh: 秒；应不小于初始等待和最短稳定时间。
description.en: Seconds; must be at least the initial wait and minimum quiet period.

description.zh: 秒；确认文件写入边界的间隔。
description.en: Seconds used to confirm a file-write boundary.

description.zh: 至少 1 个目录；限制同时处理的目录数量。
description.en: At least 1 folder. Limits how many folders are processed concurrently.

description.zh: 秒；停止文件观察器的最长等待时间。
description.en: Seconds allowed for a file observer to stop.

description.zh: 监控空闲后释放可重建的运行缓存。
description.en: Release rebuildable runtime caches when Watch is idle.

description.zh: 秒；持续空闲多久后释放缓存。
description.en: Idle seconds before caches are released.

description.zh: 秒；合并短时间内重复的密码重试。
description.en: Seconds used to combine repeated password retries.

description.zh: 监控剪贴板变化，将密码候选保存在历史中。
description.en: Observe clipboard changes and keep password candidates in history.

description.zh: 至少 1 条；超过上限时移除旧历史。
description.en: At least 1 entry. Older history is removed above this limit.

description.zh: 主程序默认启动监控；要控制当前运行的监控，请使用任务页按钮。
description.en: Enable Watch by default. Use the Tasks page to control the running monitor.

description.zh: 每行一个目录。也可以在任务页直接添加和编辑监控目录。
description.en: One folder per line. Monitored folders can also be added and edited on the Tasks page.

description.zh: 未单独设置输出位置的监控目录使用此值；“.” 表示输入目录旁。
description.en: Used when a monitored folder has no output override. “.” means beside the input.

description.zh: 监控运行时在通知区域显示图标。
description.en: Show a notification-area icon while Watch is running.

description.zh: 显示解压进度和结果通知。
description.en: Show extraction progress and completion notifications.

description.zh: 毫秒，至少 10；进度通知的更新间隔。
description.en: Milliseconds, at least 10. Interval between progress updates.

description.zh: 毫秒；合并连续完成的结果通知。
description.en: Milliseconds used to combine completion notifications.

description.zh: 天，至少 1；旧报告超过期限后清理。
description.en: Days, at least 1. Older reports are cleaned up.

description.zh: 至少 1 份；保留的报告文件数量上限。
description.en: At least 1 report. Maximum number of retained report files.

description.zh: 字节，至少 1024；报告占用的空间上限。
description.en: Bytes, at least 1024. Maximum space used by reports.

description.zh: 保存监控日志和状态；留空使用数据目录中的 .sunpack_watch。
description.en: Stores logs and state. Leave blank for .sunpack_watch in the data folder.

description.zh: 允许将剪贴板文本作为解压密码候选。
description.en: Allow clipboard text as password candidates.

description.zh: 要求完整结果，或允许从受损、不完整的压缩包中恢复部分内容。
description.en: Require complete output, or allow partial recovery from damaged or incomplete archives.

description.zh: 查找夹在其他数据中的压缩包，包括前后带无效数据的载体。
description.en: Find archives embedded in other data, including leading or trailing unrelated bytes.

description.zh: 取值 0–1；控制内嵌压缩包进入递归候选的比例阈值。
description.en: From 0 to 1. Ratio threshold for embedded archives to become recursion candidates.

description.zh: 在处理输入时复用规划结果。
description.en: Reuse input planning results while processing inputs.

description.zh: 非负整数；输入规划缓存的条数上限。
description.en: Non-negative integer. Maximum cached input plans.

description.zh: 至少 1；Rust 分析允许的并发读取数量。
description.en: At least 1. Concurrent reads allowed in Rust analysis.

description.zh: MiB；Rust 分析共享缓存的空间预算。
description.en: MiB budget for the shared Rust analysis cache.

description.zh: MiB；分析一个压缩包最多读取的数据量。
description.en: Maximum MiB read while analyzing one archive.

description.zh: 先读取文件头尾，为唯一的 Rust 分析链路提供证据。
description.en: Read the file head and tail as evidence for the shared Rust analysis pipeline.

description.zh: 字节；预分析读取的文件头长度。
description.en: Bytes read from the file head during pre-analysis.

description.zh: 字节；预分析读取的文件尾长度。
description.en: Bytes read from the file tail during pre-analysis.

description.zh: 取值 0–1；判断可解压候选的置信度阈值。
description.en: From 0 to 1. Confidence threshold for extractable candidates.

description.en: Check exit signals, output and available archive information.

description.en: Clean up incomplete output after verification failure.
